title: Global Simulation-Guided Dynamic Operator Scheduling for Efficient Multi-Tenant Model Serving
abstract: arXiv:2608.15762v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Container-granularity scheduling leaves abundant short-lived idle slices within containers unexploited. Reallocating containers is too heavyweight to utilize such fine-grained opportunities under SLA constraints, and operator-level scheduling requires reasoning about dependencies, memory safety, and cluster-wide execution dynamics in real time.   In this paper, we present SliceScheduler, a dynamic operator-level scheduling system for multi-tenant model serving. The key idea is to expose cluster-wide operator execution state and enable what-if reasoning over scheduling decisions. SliceScheduler consists of four key components. First, we introduce the Global Mapping Graph (GMG), a unified abstraction that captures operator dependencies, tensor shapes, resource mappings, and execution states, providing a real-time, cluster-wide view with explicit resource semantics. translated_title: 全局仿真引导的动态算子调度，用于高效多租户模型服务
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15762v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：容器粒度的调度在容器内部留下了大量短暂的闲置时间片，未被利用。重新分配容器过于重量级，难以在SLA约束下利用这种细粒度的机会，而算子级调度需要实时推理依赖关系、内存安全和集群范围的执行动态。在本文中，我们提出了SliceScheduler，一个用于多租户模型服务的动态算子级调度系统。关键思想是暴露集群范围的算子执行状态，并支持对调度决策的“假设”推理。SliceScheduler由四个关键组件组成。首先，我们引入了全局映射图（GMG），这是一个统一抽象，捕获算子依赖、张量形状、资源映射和执行状态，提供具有明确资源语义的实时集群范围视图。其次，我们在GMG之上构建了一个全局模拟器，用于预测算子级执行动态。
tldr: 本文提出SliceScheduler，通过全局映射图和模拟器实现动态算子级调度，利用容器内闲置时间片提升多租户模型服务的效率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes SliceScheduler, a dynamic operator-level scheduling system using global mapping graphs and simulation to exploit idle slices within containers for efficient multi-tenant model serving.
